name: שברים חלקיים – מונה ממעלה 3 מעל ריבוע של גורם לינארי, עם חילוק (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express

\[ {{CT:0}}, \]

as a sum of partial fractions.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: The numerator has a higher degree than the denominator, so we divide first; then the remainder over the repeated linear factor is split into partial fractions.
Step 1 — Polynomial division
We note that the numerator

\[ {{CT:1}} \]

is cubic and that the denominator

\[ {{CT:2}}={{CT:3}} \]

is quadratic. Dividing {{CT:4}} by {{CT:5}} we obtain a linear term of the form {{CT:6}} and a linear remainder of the form {{CT:7}} and

\[ {{CT:1}} = ({{CT:3}})({{CT:8}})+{{CT:9}}. \]

Expanding out the brackets we find

\[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:10}}+{{CT:9}}. \]

Matching coefficients we see that \(g={{CT:11}}\) and that \(h={{CT:12}}-{{CT:13}}={{CT:12}}-{{CT:14}}={{CT:15}}\). Also

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:16}}+m+{{CT:17}}={{CT:18}} + m + {{CT:19}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:20}}\mbox{,}\\ {{CT:21}}+n={{CT:22}}+n&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:23}}\mbox{.} \end{array} \]

Therefore \(m={{CT:24}}\) and \(n={{CT:25}}\). The quotient is \({{CT:8}}={{CT:26}}\) and the remainder is \({{CT:9}}={{CT:27}}\).
Step 2 — Partial fractions of the remainder
As a sum of partial fractions

\[ {{CT:28}}=\frac{A}{{CT:29}}+\frac{B}{{CT:2}}\mbox{.} \]

Multiplying both sides through by {{CT:30}} we find:

\[ {{CT:27}}= {{CT:31}} + B\mbox{.} \]

Matching coefficients we see that \(A={{CT:32}}\) and setting \(x={{CT:33}}\) we find that \(B={{CT:34}}\) so

\[ {{CT:28}}=\frac{{CT:32}}{{CT:29}}+\frac{{CT:34}}{{CT:2}}\mbox{.} \]

Step 3 — The answer
Therefore

\[ {{CT:0}}={{CT:35}}\mbox{.} \]
